name: ue5-harness
description: Unreal Engine 5.8 Build, Replication Verification, and Automation Testing Harness

ue5_build.description: Compiles the Unreal Engine project via UBT and returns parsed JSON errors/warnings.

ue5_verify_replication.description: Performs static AST/pattern analysis on C++ files in Source/ for multiplayer and replication violations.

ue5_run_tests.description: Executes headless automation tests via UnrealEditor-Cmd in null-rhi mode and returns JSON results.
